text.p: Investors should avoid buying shares of Polish trader Universal SA due to the company's muddled structure and low quality earnings, Flemings Research in London said.
"Despite interesting aspects, a minefield of potential problems makes Universal a company to avoid," the report dated July 8 said.
Universal has interests in at least 50 companies in a variety of sectors, which include broadcasting, media, heavy engineering, industrial and consumer goods, food and transport.
The report said that due to the unclear structure of its holding Universal's trading turnover was expected to decline further.
"Trading turnover has been in continuous decline since 1992, and given the structure of products that the company is involved in trading, it can be expected to continue to decline," the report said.
Flemings also expressed doubts on whether the company would match its 60-million-zloty group net profit forecast for 1997.
